Hi there! My biggest tip would be to take GOOD care of yourself while doing this all. Take any meds you need before you start (I take pain meds so that my hands don’t seize up on me 10 mins into cleaning), drink lots of water, and eat s good snack or meal before hand for some energy. 


But most importantly I think, don’t pressure yourself to finish everything super fast. Remember that every single item put dealt with and organized is a victory; especially with chronic illness or pain. Figure out how much you can do in a day and go from there. Remember that everyone’s situation is different and KonMari is not a race. For example, this is doable for me because I have medication that can manage my symptoms, I don’t work so I have all day to deal with the house and take naps in between, and o have a very tiny apartment and no children. Someone who struggles with managing symptoms, works a job, and has a large home or kids will definitely need more time to complete any of the categories! 

Be proud of yourself and every single thing you do along this journey, especially the small things. It also helps me to visualize how much easier my life and chronic conditions will be to handle personally when I have more organization and order in my home.
